Toledo ranks 56th on defense, allowing its opponents at convert at 34.9%. Toledo ranks 128th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 100.0% of trips. Tyler Mizzell led Ball State with 164 yards on 16-of-27 passing (59.3%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. Jalen Bonds carried the ball 11 times for 36 yards and scored one touchdown, adding five receptions for 57 yards. Hamilton put up 80 yards on seven catches with one touchdown.
